description:
## Problem
`static_matrix_drift` in benchbox/core/tuning/coverage.py reports only cells whose status got worse, so a TSV that says `waived` where a template now exists passes. That is how the ClickHouse rows went stale while PR #2677 added templates, and the stale rows were found only by a reviewer. Also: the module docstring (lines 3-5) and `template_path_for` (line ~101) still describe a single `examples/tunings/{platform}/` lookup although `classify_template` now also checks the family directory; and the new `TEMPLATE_PLATFORM_KEYS` in benchbox/core/tuning/packaged_templates.py repeats four entries of `capability_registry.PLATFORM_ALIASES` without saying why it must stay separate (that map also sends spark to databricks, which is wrong for template lookup).

## Change
- Make the checked-in matrix test assert exact equality with the generated rows (with a clear regeneration command in the failure message), or flag upgrades as drift too.
- Update the docstrings and add a one-line comment on `TEMPLATE_PLATFORM_KEYS`.

## Guardrails
- Intentional waivers stay possible and visible.
